methods.name: study.overview
methods.description: Read deck counts, description, buried cards and study limits.

methods.name: study.next
methods.description: Render the current queued card, or null when the session is finished.

methods.name: study.answer
methods.description: Commit a rating using the shown card's scheduling snapshot and report leech actions.

methods.name: study.replayAnswers
methods.description: Apply journaled answers to each card's current state in order, skipping missing, suspended or buried cards.

methods.name: study.undo
methods.description: Undo the latest undoable collection operation, optionally guarding its revision.

methods.name: study.redo
methods.description: Redo the latest reverted collection operation, optionally guarding its revision.

methods.name: study.undoStatus
methods.description: Read undo and redo availability and action labels.

methods.name: study.compareTypedAnswer
methods.description: Use the engine's type-answer comparison for the rendered card.

methods.name: study.congratulations
methods.description: Read session totals, limits and next-due information.

methods.name: study.customStudyDefaults
methods.description: Read native custom-study limits, availability and tag defaults.

methods.name: study.customStudy
methods.description: Adjust today's limits or build a custom-study filtered deck.

methods.name: study.unbury
methods.description: Unbury cards in a deck by manual or sibling-burial state.
